text: release.sh: half-released tree on failure, a signing guard that fails open, no versionCode check

Landed in 9327a81. A trap restores the five bumped files, web_dist and the embedded APK on any non-zero exit while HEAD is unchanged (chosen over printing a recovery command, because the earlier incident WAS the command not being run), and it never touches a commit that already landed; git add is now path-scoped rather than -A. The signing guard is fatal when a previous certificate exists but cannot be read, with a RELEASE_FIRST_RELEASE escape hatch, and the reassuring line prints only after a real comparison. versionCode is now checked against the previously embedded APK in preconditions. Plus: strict version increase, --notes with a missing file dies, release-guard refuses a protocol decrease, every cd has || exit. The agent also put the assembleRelease online fallback and npm ci here rather than in T-281 and flagged it.
